intent.outcome: A three-crate workspace (mp-model, mp, raul): a shared pure-types crate (mp-model) holds the 61 domain structs already isolated in mp/src/model.rs; mp keeps all logic/store/validate/CLI; raul depends on mp-model for types and shells out to mp --format json for every plan operation, rendering milestones/steps/progress with styled tables and delegating idea writes to mp. mp stays the sole plan writer; raul is the polished human surface; the JSON contract remains the operation seam.

problem.description: mp serves two audiences in one binary: agents (--format json, the stable programmatic API) and humans (--format human/markdown/pr-body, mp digest, mp graph). The human surfaces are agent-grade: terse, non-interactive, no drill-down. Humans reviewing the plan want styled tables, filters, drill-down, and a done-but-not-released dashboard. Splitting the human surface into a dedicated raul CLI lets each tool be optimized for its audience, and forces raul to consume mp --format json — reinforcing the JSON contract as the stable agent API.

in_scope: Extract crates/mp-model: move the pure domain types from mp/src/model.rs (already I/O-free) into crates/mp-model with serde derives + the TomlResource trait (interface only); mp depends on it via path dep and re-exports so mp internals are unchanged; all existing mp tests still pass
New binary raul in crates/raul, co-released with mp from this repo; raul depends on mp-model (types only)
MpRunner helper: shells out to mp <cmd> --format json, deserializes into mp-model types, surfaces non-zero exits as raul errors
raul shares ONLY mp-model types; never depends on mp logic/store/validate/CLI; all plan reads/writes flow through mp JSON process boundary
Read views: status, list milestones, show milestone <id>, next, path
Write surface: ideas only, delegated to mp idea create via shell (raul has zero plan-file writes — it physically cannot, since mp-model has no write capability)
Human-polish views: raul digest + raul graph (replace human modes of mp digest/graph)
Styling via comfy-table + owo-colors (minimal deps, M21 dep-diet consistent)
make target + workspace wiring so cargo build/release produces mp-model, mp, and raul
out_of_scope: Linking mp logic/store/validate/CLI/handlers into raul (types-only sharing via mp-model is the red line)
Direct plan-file writes from raul (always delegate to mp)
A separate git repo (kept in this repo for tight coupling)
Full feature parity with every mp --format human mode (7 views only)
Shared rendering helpers (rendering is audience-specific; mp render.rs stays agent-grade, raul stays human-polished)

steps.action: Extract crates/mp-model: move the pure domain types from mp/src/model.rs (61 types, already I/O-free) into a new crates/mp-model crate with serde derives + the TomlResource trait (interface only, no impls). mp gains a path dep on mp-model and re-exports the types so internal modules are unchanged. Verify mp-model/src has no fs/store/validate imports.
steps.done_when: crates/mp-model exists as pure types-only crate; mp depends on it via path and re-exports; mp-model/src has zero I/O imports; basic serde round-trip tests live in crates/mp-model/ guarding the shared types; cargo test -p mp full suite green

steps.action: Create crates/raul skeleton: Cargo.toml (name=raul, deps on mp-model + clap + serde + serde_json + anyhow), src/main.rs + src/cli.rs minimal clap root. Add crates/raul to workspace members. Add make target so make build covers mp-model + mp + raul. raul --version prints a version.
steps.done_when: cargo build --release produces target/release/raul; raul --version works; make build builds all three crates

steps.action: Implement MpRunner helper in raul: shells out to mp <cmd> --format json from the raul plan/project dir, captures stdout, deserializes into the appropriate mp-model type (or serde_json::Value), surfaces non-zero exits and missing-mp errors as clean raul errors. Gate test asserts raul source imports no mp logic modules (only mp-model types).
steps.done_when: MpRunner exists; raul runs a trivial read (e.g. wrap mp status) end-to-end; raul inherits cwd so mp resolves the plan identically and forwards --project-root/--plan-dir when raul receives them; MpRunner detects mp missing from PATH and emits a clear actionable error; gate test confirms raul imports no mp logic/store/validate/CLI (only mp-model)

steps.action: Implement raul status: wraps mp status --format json, renders progress (done/planned/verified counts), inbox count, blockers, and suggested next step as a styled human table.
steps.done_when: raul status prints a readable styled summary sourced from mp status JSON; no plan-file access in raul

steps.action: Implement raul list milestones and raul show milestone <id>: wrap mp list milestones / mp show milestone JSON, render a milestones table and a drill-down detail view (steps + ACs + WPs + status) with colors and structure.
steps.done_when: raul list milestones and raul show milestone <id> render structured drill-down views from mp JSON

steps.action: Implement raul next and raul path: wrap mp next-step / mp path JSON, render a what's-next view (next action + preview chain) and a path view (ordered upcoming milestones/steps).
steps.done_when: raul next and raul path render the execution queue readably from mp JSON

steps.action: Implement raul idea: prompt the user for an idea title (+ optional description), shell out to mp idea create with the captured input. Assert via test that raul itself has no code path that writes any plan TOML file (no save_toml, no atomic_write, no fs::write to master-plan/) — only the mp idea create delegation.
steps.done_when: raul idea captures input and creates an idea via mp; gate test confirms raul source contains no plan-file write path

steps.action: Implement raul digest and raul graph: wrap mp digest / mp graph JSON and render the human-facing versions (stakeholder summary, dependency/coverage graph) — replacing the need for humans to call mp's human modes.
steps.done_when: raul digest and raul graph render human-facing views from mp JSON

steps.action: Styling pass across all raul views: consistent colors (owo-colors), tables (comfy-table), headers, spacing, and error/empty-state presentation. Verify final build + that raul deps (comfy-table/owo-colors) do not leak into the mp crate.
steps.tests: cargo tree -p mp | grep -E 'comfy-table|owo-colors' && exit 1 || make build
steps.done_when: All raul views share a consistent styled presentation; cargo tree -p mp shows no comfy-table/owo-colors; make build green

steps.action: JSON-contract audit: for each raul view (status, list milestones, show milestone, next, path, idea, digest, graph), enumerate the exact mp command and the JSON fields the renderer needs. Verify mp --format json emits every required field. Flag any gaps; where mp JSON is incomplete for a view, record either a multi-call strategy or an mp-JSON-extension follow-up.
steps.tests: manual: accepted — JSON-contract audit mapping review
steps.done_when: A documented mapping (view -> mp command -> required fields) exists; every raul view's required fields are confirmed present in mp JSON, or an explicit gap/follow-up is recorded
